status: Twelve-family scope policy; original22 definitions plus initial19 acquisition checklist; live promotion and rights status in task_registry.json
counting_policy: Assign each scientific input/output task one primary family. Other chemical domains and modalities are tags. Do not count methods, individual output heads, evaluation axes or reused sources as independent tasks.

families.title: Reaction data acquisition and curation
families.scope: Extract records from text, tables and diagrams; resolve entities and roles; normalize, validate, deduplicate and repair reaction records with provenance.
families.gaps: Expert title/abstract entities and conversion relations plus controlled deletion references are acquired. Full-paper diagrams/tables, naturally observed database corrections and adjudicated entity-resolution cases remain gaps.

families.title: Reaction representation, organisation and search
families.scope: Atom correspondence, stoichiometric completion and conservation, classification, clustering, reaction similarity and retrieval.
families.gaps: Expert-linked chemical-pair-to-document retrieval is acquired; unannotated gallery relevance remains unknown. Broader mechanistic similarity, homology and scalable deduplication evaluation require separate references.

families.title: Single-step reaction transformation
families.scope: Forward products, one-step precursor sets, reaction centers and bond edits; recorded or permissible alternatives require explicit reference semantics.
families.gaps: Standardized endpoint-isolated contracts and source-index qualification are pending. One recorded precursor set is not exhaustive acceptable chemistry. Multi-step target-to-stock route search is excluded.

families.title: Reaction outcomes, feasibility and robustness
families.scope: Yield, conversion and assay response; observed success/failure; proposal feasibility; sensitivity and transfer under declared perturbations.

task_groups.title: Reaction feasibility
task_groups.reference_policy: Observed condition-specific success and expert proposal plausibility are separate endpoints. Generated negatives remain an optional, separately reported reference tier.

families.molecular_accessibility_review: feasibility_structure.md; optional adjacent endpoint, not admitted or counted in the 41-task registry
families.gaps: Robustness needs linked perturbations or a qualified transfer population; current response and feasibility labels do not by themselves provide that evidence. Generated negatives, expert judgments and measured failures remain separate.

families.title: Selectivity, mixtures and side products
families.scope: Regio-, chemo- and stereoselectivity, per-product compositions, competing pathways, side products and impurities.
families.gaps: Identified benzaldehyde side-product profiles and explicitly reported solid-state impurity phases are acquired. Missing impurity reports are unknown. Organic open-world impurity identities and general chemo/diastereoselectivity remain gaps.

families.title: Conditions, procedures and experimental design
families.scope: Recover recorded recipes; rank measured settings; select informative experiments; generate procedures and laboratory actions within one reaction system.
families.gaps: Source-qualified panels, utility and failure policies are required. Offline selection does not prove prospective performance, and action-sequence agreement does not prove successful execution. Dynamic physical execution is assigned to process control.

families.title: Reaction physics, energetics and kinetics
families.scope: Activation and reaction energies, rates and rate laws, reactive energy/force fields and inference of kinetic parameters from observations.
families.gaps: Native reactive energy/force trajectories and scoped inverse-kinetics simulations are acquired; surface/periodic context, experimental rate-law identification and broader mechanism families remain gaps. Computed HAT rates are not experimental kinetic measurements.

families.title: Mechanisms, reactive pathways and networks
families.scope: Electron events and ordered mechanisms, transition-state structures, elementary reaction pathways, reaction-network discovery and microkinetic dynamics.
families.gaps: Native endpoint/TS geometries and two published simulated network examples are acquired. Geometry-only subsets lack full per-row charge/spin or independently rerun saddle validation. Experimental microkinetic identifiability and broad network families remain gaps.

families.title: Analytical characterization and reaction monitoring
families.scope: Infer identities and compositions from spectra, chromatograms or images; infer reaction progress, endpoints and anomalies from time-dependent signals.
families.gaps: Native NMR trajectories and low-field yield-time profiles are acquired. Integration targets are derived analytical areas, not independent absolute concentrations. Broad MS/IR/multimodal structures and prospective endpoints need further references.

families.title: Catalyst/reagent design and new reactivity
families.scope: Inverse design of catalysts, ligands, reagents or media; discover and verify new transformations or substrate scope under an explicit experiment budget.
families.gaps: Recorded ORD component-performance pairs and a catalytic enzyme-design subset provide finite measured lookup oracles; Minot provides bounded retrospective substrate-scope hits. Off-library performance and globally novel transformation discovery remain unmeasured.

families.title: Reaction engineering and process assessment
families.scope: Reactor and scale-dependent behaviour, mixing/transport, dynamic operation and control, materials/energy/cost/waste and operational hazard assessment for a reaction process.
families.gaps: Measured reactor geometry/response, pilot-scale observations, published CSTR simulations and coke-yield quantities are acquired. Some scale-up descendants are interpolations; process impact is a narrow coke quantity, without complete energy/cost/LCA/hazard coverage.

families.title: Biocatalysis and enzyme–reaction function
families.scope: Assay activity, reaction-conditioned enzyme retrieval, sequence/structure function, mutation effects, catalytic sites and enzyme kinetic parameters; enzyme design can also carry the design tag.
families.gaps: Native enzyme/reaction associations, explicit assay mutation effects, direct M-CSA catalytic residues and BRENDA-record kinetic references are acquired. DMS proxies are separately tagged; native reaction retrieval still needs homology-aware evaluation and reaction-specific catalytic-site claims need qualification.

future_tasks.title: Literature reaction extraction
future_tasks.question: Source document text, tables and diagrams -> reaction records linked to supporting evidence
future_tasks.required_data: Document-disjoint corpus with linked entity, role, structure and reaction-record references; access and redistribution terms
future_tasks.evaluation: Entity/record precision and recall, structure agreement, evidence linkage and document coverage; record extraction errors before downstream filtering

future_tasks.title: Reaction record validation and correction
future_tasks.question: A noisy reaction record -> diagnosed issues and source-supported corrections or abstention
future_tasks.required_data: Independently adjudicated original/error/corrected records with evidence, including ambiguous and unrepairable records
future_tasks.evaluation: Error detection and correction accuracy, false-edit rate and coverage; conservation checks alone are not truth labels

future_tasks.title: Reaction similarity and retrieval
future_tasks.question: A reaction or partial-reaction query -> relevant analogues or precedents
future_tasks.required_data: Query/gallery split, graded relevance judgments and parent/source deduplication; source class equality alone is an imperfect relevance proxy
future_tasks.evaluation: Recall at k, nDCG and query coverage under declared relevance and near-duplicate policies

future_tasks.title: Side-product and impurity identification
future_tasks.question: Reaction and operating context -> side-product structures and, when measured, abundances
future_tasks.required_data: Identified minor products, detection limits, measured absences and context-linked analytical evidence
future_tasks.evaluation: Structure-set recovery and detection-limited abundance error; unreported species are not automatically absent

future_tasks.title: Reactive energies and forces
future_tasks.question: Atomic configuration and physical context -> energy and forces in reactive regions
future_tasks.required_data: Reactive geometries, consistent energies/forces, theory and partitioned trajectories or reaction systems
future_tasks.evaluation: Energy/force errors and declared reactive-trajectory diagnostics; adjacent trajectory frames must not cross splits

future_tasks.title: Kinetic parameter and rate-law inference
future_tasks.question: Time-resolved concentration or signal observations and context -> identifiable kinetic parameters or rate law
future_tasks.required_data: Calibrated trajectories and conditions, kinetic-model assumptions, identifiable reference parameters and uncertainty
future_tasks.evaluation: Parameter error where identifiable, held-out trajectory agreement and uncertainty; trajectory fit alone does not identify a unique mechanism

future_tasks.title: Transition-state geometry
future_tasks.question: Reaction endpoints and physical context -> candidate transition-state structures
future_tasks.required_data: Geometry references, charge/spin, theory, connectivity and transition-state qualification
future_tasks.evaluation: Symmetry-aware structural error, qualified saddle-point recovery and coverage

future_tasks.title: Elementary reaction networks and microkinetics
future_tasks.question: Initial species, physical conditions and allowed evidence -> elementary network and/or its kinetic evolution
future_tasks.required_data: Declared network boundary, species/reaction references, rates and held-out dynamical observations; completeness and missing pathways qualified
future_tasks.evaluation: Qualified edge/path recovery and species-time agreement as separate variants; not target-to-stock synthesis route search

future_tasks.title: Reaction-mixture analytical interpretation
future_tasks.question: Spectra, chromatograms or analytical images -> component identities or calibrated composition
future_tasks.required_data: Raw signals linked to independently identified mixtures, concentrations, instrument settings and detection limits
future_tasks.evaluation: Identification precision/recall, concentration error and coverage; mixture and instrument groups retained

future_tasks.title: Reaction progress, endpoint and anomaly monitoring
future_tasks.question: Observed signal history -> current progress, endpoint status or operational anomaly
future_tasks.required_data: Time-stamped trajectories with independent progress/end-state/anomaly references and no future-signal input leakage
future_tasks.evaluation: Progress error and endpoint/anomaly timing metrics as named variants; entire experiment trajectories kept together

future_tasks.title: Reaction-conditioned component design
future_tasks.question: Reaction and desired response -> novel catalyst, ligand, reagent, medium or biocatalyst candidates
future_tasks.required_data: Structural design space, known-data exposure, independent performance oracle or experiments, feasibility constraints and evaluation budget
future_tasks.evaluation: Verified performance, validity, novelty, diversity and failures under a common budget; different component roles are variants, not automatically separate task counts

future_tasks.title: New reactivity and substrate-scope discovery
future_tasks.question: Allowed chemical space and prior observations -> novel experimentally verified transformations or scope expansion
future_tasks.required_data: Time-resolved discovery campaigns, attempted failures, novelty definitions and independently verified products; an untested proposal is not a discovery
future_tasks.evaluation: Verified novel hits and useful scope coverage versus experiment budget; distinguish from scoring a fixed feasibility label

future_tasks.title: Reactor and scale-dependent prediction
future_tasks.question: Reaction, geometry, scale, transport and operating conditions -> reactor-scale response or fields
future_tasks.required_data: Linked reactor/scale datasets with geometry, mixing/transport descriptors, boundary conditions and measured responses
future_tasks.evaluation: Response/field errors on held-out reactors and scales; simple reaction-domain transfer does not establish scale-up

future_tasks.title: Dynamic reaction-process operation and control
future_tasks.question: Sensor history, process state and operating constraints -> physical control actions
future_tasks.required_data: Action/observation trajectories and a validated simulator or experimental evaluation environment with operational constraints
future_tasks.evaluation: Attained objective, constraint violations, failures and resources; differs from choosing one next experiment in a fixed offline pool

future_tasks.title: Reaction-process resource and impact assessment
future_tasks.question: Reaction recipe, scale and declared process boundary -> material/energy use, cost, waste or operational hazard quantity
future_tasks.required_data: Measured or audited target-specific process inventories, prices/factors and conditions; cost, footprint and hazard remain distinct reference-qualified variants
future_tasks.evaluation: Source-specific quantity errors and decision agreement; no universal sustainability or safety score is assumed

future_tasks.title: Enzyme–reaction retrieval
future_tasks.question: Reaction and available context -> active enzyme sequences or structures
future_tasks.required_data: Sequence-linked positive/negative activity references, candidate universe and family-aware partitions
future_tasks.evaluation: Retrieval recall/ranking, activity recovery and coverage; unlabeled candidates are not confirmed inactive

future_tasks.title: Enzyme mutation effects
future_tasks.question: Enzyme sequence, mutation and reaction/assay context -> measured change in function
future_tasks.required_data: Linked wild-type/mutant measurements with assay conditions, units and sequence-family groups
future_tasks.evaluation: Native-quantity error and within-assay ordering; sequence or assay overlap disclosed

future_tasks.title: Reaction-conditioned active sites
future_tasks.question: Reaction and enzyme sequence/structure -> catalytic residues or active-site annotation
future_tasks.required_data: Reaction-linked residue references, index mapping, evidence tier and structure/sequence group separation
future_tasks.evaluation: Residue precision/recall, localization and coverage; annotation agreement is not independent catalytic proof

future_tasks.title: Enzyme kinetic-parameter prediction
future_tasks.question: Enzyme sequence, reaction/substrate and assay conditions -> source-defined kinetic parameter
future_tasks.required_data: Sequence-linked kcat, Km or Ki measurements with units, temperature, pH and assay context
future_tasks.evaluation: Parameter-specific log/native errors and sequence/substrate transfer; kcat, Km and Ki are distinct quantities and never pooled as rate constants

excluded_tasks.title: Multi-step synthesis route planning
excluded_tasks.reason: Explicit user scope decision: do not develop a competing target-to-stock route-search benchmark or seek to replace PaRoutes.
excluded_tasks.boundary: Excludes multi-step synthetic route search, route ranking/diversity and route-level optimization. Keeps single-step precursor prediction, per-reaction experimental decisions and physical elementary reaction networks.

input_modalities: reactor geometry, process variables and sensor histories
evaluation: data quality, provenance, licenses and reproducibility
cross_cutting_axes.coverage_rule: Each axis needs an evidence matrix. Listing a domain, modality or evaluation dimension does not establish data or results for it. General molecular-property prediction, unrelated biology and plant/supply-chain optimization are outside the reaction-centred boundary.

delivery_policy: After acquisition, pilot and freeze each task variant, group allocation, model interface and measured resource budget. Source-backed coverage and redistribution clearance do not imply completed predictive benchmarks. The release manifest selects only explicit eligible paths and excludes contradictory or unresolved grants.
future_tasks_semantics: Historical initial acquisition checklist, retained to reproduce the fixed41-definition universe. Presence here does not mean still unacquired: task_registry.json computes current future_tasks and promoted_roadmap_task_ids from qualified source catalogs.
